resources.string: Control the app through an authenticated loopback connection

Enable an HTTP API on 127.0.0.1:9091. Anyone with its token can read proxy credentials, change profiles and settings, restore backups, and approve installed plugins. Keep the token private. Android permission checks still apply.
Listening on 127.0.0.1:%1$d. Use the token to authenticate local requests. Disabling the API closes the listener without stopping the VPN.
Connected clients will need the new token. Operations already accepted may finish.
Could not start the local API. Check its configuration and whether its port is available.
